name: casual-chitchat
description: Ten minutes of pleasant nothing while a client call is delayed — weekend plans, weather, tea orders. There is no live need a companion could help with; the only correct behaviour is silence at every check.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: They've pushed the client call by half an hour, so we're just hanging about.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Typical. More coffee for me, then.

utterances.speaker: Marcus
utterances.text: Anyone catch the weather for the weekend? Supposed to be lovely on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Apparently, yeah. We're thinking of taking the kids to the coast.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Nice. We did Brighton a couple of weeks ago — the queue for chips was an hour long.

utterances.speaker: Marcus
utterances.text: An hour! For chips!

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Worth it though, I bet.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Honestly, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Marcus
utterances.text: Did you get up to much last night?

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Just the football and an early night. Riveting stuff.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: I started that pottery class I kept going on about.

utterances.speaker: Marcus
utterances.text: How was it?

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: I made what is technically a bowl. It wobbles.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: A wobbly bowl is still a bowl.

utterances.speaker: Marcus
utterances.text: Words to live by.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Right, I'm grabbing a tea before they join. Anyone want anything?

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: I'm alright, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Marcus
utterances.text: Go on then — builder's, splash of milk.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Two minutes.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: I might stretch my legs as well.

utterances.speaker: Marcus
utterances.text: I'll hold the fort. If they join early I'll stall with my legendary small talk.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: We've all witnessed the small talk. Stall gently.

utterances.speaker: Marcus
utterances.text: No promises.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Back. They said five more minutes.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Plenty of time for another biscuit, then.
